confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on third-party cost-of-living aggregators and travel guides that disagree (inexpensive meal about $10-20, mid-range three-course meal for two about $40-83), so they are bounded estimates, not menu checks. Beer and cocktail come from scattered figures ($3.32 Numbeo-style draft beer, $5-10 bar drinks, about $12 cocktail in one guide). Wine is derived from the beer price (about 2x), not observed. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no accommodation search was run and no live listings were checked. The FX observation is stale: the most recent RBA value I could verify was 20 March 2026, not a value from the generation date, so AUD conversions may be out of date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Caribbean is not an available region option, so Latin America was chosen as the nearest. Restaurant prices were benchmarked against aggregator comparisons to US-level pricing, with the mid-range meal and coffee anchors near US levels. Accommodation was estimated from general knowledge of Willemstad's guesthouse, hostel and mid-range hotel tiers, with the hotel tiers allowing for high-season uplift.
